title: GUI-Libra: Training Native GUI Agents to Reason and Act with Action-aware Supervision and Partially Verifiable RL
authors_zh: Rui Yang, Qianhui Wu, Zhaoyang Wang, Hanyang Chen, Ke Yang, Hao Cheng, Huaxiu Yao, Baolin Peng, Huan Zhang, Jianfeng Gao, Tong Zhang
paper_type_zh: GUI 推理数据集与后训练配方
best_for_zh: 适合构造原生 GUI agent 推理与动作监督数据的研究者。
one_line: GUI-Libra turns public GUI trajectories into 81K action-aligned reasoning steps and trains native agents with action-aware SFT and conservative RL under ambiguous step rewards.
GUI-Libra 将公开 GUI 轨迹整理为 81K 条动作对齐推理记录，并用 action-aware SFT 与保守 RL 处理逐步奖励存在歧义的问题。
why: It exposes the record schema, filters, and reward ambiguity needed to judge whether offline GUI supervision will transfer to online task completion.
inclusion_reason: Releases action-aligned GUI reasoning records and shows how their filtering and consumption affect native GUI-agent post-training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open native GUI agents can ground single actions but still fail on long-horizon tasks because public trajectories contain little action-aligned reasoning. Generic long-CoT SFT can also reduce coordinate grounding, while step-wise RL marks valid alternative actions wrong when only one demonstration is available.

GUI-Libra addresses both failures by curating existing web/mobile trajectories into 81K reasoning-action steps, training with action-weighted mixed supervision, and constraining RL under partially verifiable rewards. The output is a dataset plus a two-stage post-training recipe for native GUI agents.

L4 facts: arXiv:2602.22190v2, 25 May 2026; arXiv preprint, no confirmed venue; decision boundary is action agreement, coordinate alignment, and partially verifiable step reward; Track-01 object is a screenshot/context/reasoning/executable-action record; collected as an existing promoted Card.

开源原生 GUI agent 虽能完成单步定位，但在长程任务上仍常失败，因为公开轨迹缺少与动作对齐的推理。通用长 CoT SFT 还可能降低坐标定位能力；逐步 RL 只有一条示范动作时，又会把其它有效动作误判为错误。

GUI-Libra 通过把已有网页和移动端轨迹整理为 81K 条推理与动作记录、使用动作加权的混合监督，并在部分可验证奖励下约束 RL 来处理这两个问题。直接产物是一套数据集和面向原生 GUI agent 的两阶段后训练配方。

L4 事实：官方来源为 arXiv:2602.22190v2，日期为 2026-05-25；目前仅确认 arXiv 预印本，未确认正式会议；判定边界包括动作一致性、坐标对齐和部分可验证的逐步奖励；Track 01 对象是截图、文本上下文、推理与可执行动作组成的记录；该条目是已有并已提升的 Card。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
GUI-Libra makes GUI reasoning supervision actionable by coupling each rationale to a structured executable action, filtering their alignment, emphasizing action/grounding tokens during SFT, and limiting policy drift when offline rewards cannot recognize every valid action. The primary data object is a reasoning-action step, the feedback contract mixes model-based filtering with partial step reward, and the work belongs here because those records are consumed directly by SFT and RL rather than serving only as an environment benchmark.

Google Scholar citations: 6（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=GUI-Libra%3A+Training+Native+GUI+Agents+to+Reason+and+Act+with+Action-aware+Supervision+and+Partially+Verifiable+RL&author=Rui+Yang&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset name: GUI-Libra-81K. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/GUI-Libra. Scale: 81K steps from 9K trajectories, with a 40K-step RL subset. Record form: screenshot, system-level instruction, user instruction, interaction history, reasoning trace, and JSON action fields. File/storage format: not confirmed on the inspected paper/project page. Domains/languages: web and mobile GUI tasks, including a Chinese GUIAct subset. Construction/filtering: GPT-4.1 augments rationales/actions; Qwen3-VL checks action agreement and coordinate containment. License: not confirmed. Intended use: action-aware SFT and partially verifiable GUI RL.

GUI-Libra 把每段推理与结构化可执行动作绑定，过滤两者的一致性，在 SFT 中提高动作与定位 token 的权重，并在离线奖励无法识别所有有效动作时限制策略漂移，从而让 GUI 推理监督真正可执行。核心数据对象是推理与动作组成的逐步记录，反馈契约结合模型过滤和部分可验证奖励；它直接进入 SFT 与 RL，而不只是环境评测，因此属于本分类。

Google Scholar 引用数：6（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=GUI-Libra%3A+Training+Native+GUI+Agents+to+Reason+and+Act+with+Action-aware+Supervision+and+Partially+Verifiable+RL&author=Rui+Yang&hl=en）

开源数据：有。数据集名称：GUI-Libra-81K。官方地址：https://huggingface.co/GUI-Libra。规模：来自 9K 条轨迹的 81K 个步骤，另有 40K 步的 RL 子集。记录形式：截图、系统级指令、用户指令、交互历史、推理轨迹以及 JSON 动作字段。文件或存储格式：论文和已检查的项目页未确认。领域与语言：网页和移动端 GUI 任务，并包含 GUIAct 中文子集。构造与过滤：GPT-4.1 补充推理和动作，Qwen3-VL 检查动作一致性与坐标是否落在目标框内。许可：未确认。预期用途：action-aware SFT 与部分可验证的 GUI RL。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Clean source trajectories. Input: seven public web/mobile GUI datasets. Operation: remove incomplete, under-3-step, over-50-step, and unsupported compound-action trajectories. Output: 19K trajectories/170K steps. Check: schema and action-space validity.
  2. Augment structured supervision. Input: screenshot, instruction, history, annotated action, and coordinates. Operation: GPT-4.1 writes a long rationale, action description/type/target/value while retaining original coordinates. Output: reasoning-then-action JSON records. Check: parseable <think> and <answer> structure.
  3. Filter and split. Input: augmented records. Operation: run Qwen3-VL-8B ten times and require action agreement at least 0.3; require original coordinates inside a Qwen3-VL-32B target box. Output: 81K SFT steps/9K trajectories and a domain/step-balanced 40K RL subset. Check: reject disagreement, coordinate mismatch, early-step bias, and excess mobile records.
  4. Action-aware SFT. Input: full reasoning-action records plus direct-action variants. Operation: mix both forms and reweight action and grounding tokens (default weights 2 and 4). Output: an action-aligned policy. Check: fixed two-epoch baseline exposure versus one epoch on the doubled mixed set.
  5. Conservative RL. Input: the SFT policy and 40K static steps. Operation: GRPO samples eight responses, applies partial step reward, KL regularization, and success-adaptive scaling of negative gradients. Output: GUI-Libra models. Check/stop: monitor offline/online performance; KL coefficients are 0.005 for 7B and 0.001 otherwise.

Reproducibility: paper, project, code, data, and models are linked officially. Reproduction must fix source versions, GPT/Qwen annotators, coordinate convention, filtering thresholds, base checkpoints, and benchmark wrappers; release license and augmentation sampling temperature remain unconfirmed.

1. 清理来源轨迹。 输入：7 个公开网页或移动端 GUI 数据集。操作：删除不完整、少于 3 步、多于 50 步以及包含不支持复合动作的轨迹。输出：19K 条轨迹、170K 个步骤。检查：记录结构和动作空间必须合法。
  2. 补充结构化监督。 输入：截图、指令、历史、标注动作与坐标。操作：GPT-4.1 生成长推理、动作描述、类型、目标和值，同时保留原坐标。输出：先推理后动作的 JSON 记录。检查：<think> 与 <answer> 结构必须可解析。
  3. 过滤并划分。 输入：补充后的记录。操作：Qwen3-VL-8B 对每条输入运行 10 次，动作一致率至少为 0.3；原坐标还必须落在 Qwen3-VL-32B 预测的目标框内。输出：81K 个 SFT 步骤、9K 条轨迹，以及按领域和步序平衡的 40K 步 RL 子集。检查：删除动作不一致、坐标错位、过多早期步骤和过量移动端记录。
  4. 执行 action-aware SFT。 输入：完整推理动作记录及其仅动作版本。操作：混合两种监督，并提高动作 token 与定位 token 的权重，默认权重分别为 2 和 4。输出：动作对齐策略。检查：baseline 训练 2 个 epoch，规模加倍的混合集训练 1 个 epoch，以保持样本暴露量可比。
  5. 执行保守 RL。 输入：SFT 策略与 40K 个静态步骤。操作：GRPO 每组采样 8 个回答，使用部分可验证的逐步奖励、KL 正则和成功率自适应的负梯度缩放。输出：GUI-Libra 模型。检查与停止：同时监控离线和在线表现；7B 的 KL 系数为 0.005，其余模型为 0.001。

复现信息：论文、项目、代码、数据和模型均有官方链接。复现时必须固定来源版本、GPT/Qwen 标注模型、坐标约定、过滤阈值、base checkpoint 与评测封装；发布许可和补充数据时的采样温度仍未确认。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
End-to-end claim (Table 5). With Qwen3-VL-8B as the base native model, AndroidWorld success rises from 30.4 to 42.6 after the full 81K-SFT/40K-RL recipe; the 4B counterpart rises from 27.0 to 42.6. These are single-VLM results under the same 20-step evaluation, so they support transfer from static post-training to online completion, but do not isolate data curation from ASFT and RL.

Partial-verification claim (Figures 9-10). Identically initialized 3B/7B RL runs compare KL 0 with 0.001/0.005. KL-regularized checkpoints show stronger offline/online correlation (Pearson 0.89, Spearman 0.83) than no-KL checkpoints (0.63 and 0.53), while no-KL policies lose entropy despite rising training reward. This supports conservative optimization under this reward ambiguity, not a universal KL rule for fully verifiable RLVR.

端到端主张，表 5。 以 Qwen3-VL-8B 为原生 base model，完整的 81K SFT 与 40K RL 配方把 AndroidWorld 成功率从 30.4 提高到 42.6；4B 版本则从 27.0 提高到 42.6。两组都是同一 20 步评测下的单 VLM 结果，能支持静态后训练向在线完成率迁移，但无法单独区分数据整理、ASFT 和 RL 的贡献。

部分可验证主张，图 9 至图 10。 使用相同初始化的 3B/7B RL 实验比较 KL 为 0 与 0.001/0.005。加入 KL 的 checkpoint 在离线与在线指标间达到 Pearson 0.89、Spearman 0.83；不加 KL 时分别为 0.63 和 0.53，而且训练奖励上升时策略熵仍下降。这支持在本文奖励歧义下使用保守优化，但不等于完全可验证 RLVR 的通用 KL 结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior GUI-agent recipes either attach short/noisy rationales to trajectories or optimize a demonstrated action as if it were the only correct step. GUI-Libra changes the auditable record by pairing a longer rationale with structured action fields and checking target-coordinate alignment. It also changes consumption: SFT explicitly weights action/grounding tokens, while RL treats single-demonstration reward as partially verifiable and constrains policy drift. Using SFT plus RL is not new; the novelty is their action-aware data and reward contract.
以往 GUI agent 配方通常只给轨迹补充短而嘈杂的推理，或把示范动作当作唯一正确步骤来优化。GUI-Libra 改变了可审计记录：它把更长推理与结构化动作字段绑定，并检查目标与坐标是否对齐。它也改变了数据消费方式：SFT 明确提高动作与定位 token 的权重，RL 则把单示范奖励视为部分可验证并限制策略漂移。SFT 加 RL 本身并不新，新意在动作感知的数据和奖励契约。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The authors train only on existing static trajectories and leave fully online RL untested. Before reuse, test whether the static filters still predict success under the target site's live state distribution.
  • The final SFT mixture is 85.7% mobile and rare actions remain scarce. Audit source/action frequencies and collect missing web or rare-action trajectories before claiming broad GUI coverage.
  • A single demonstrated action cannot enumerate all valid next moves. Measure false-negative reward rates on alternative actions before using this verifier for aggressive RL updates.

• 作者只用已有静态轨迹训练，没有检验完全在线 RL。复用前应测试这些静态过滤器在目标网站的实时状态分布上是否仍能预测成功率。
  • 最终 SFT 数据中移动端占 85.7%，稀有动作仍很少。声称广泛 GUI 覆盖前，应审计来源与动作频率，并补充缺失的网页或稀有动作轨迹。
  • 单条示范动作无法枚举所有有效下一步。将该 verifier 用于较强 RL 更新前，应测量替代动作上的奖励假阴性率。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• If you have GUI trajectories with screenshots and actions but weak rationales, reuse the augmentation, agreement, and coordinate-containment stages to produce reasoning-action SFT records; validate with held-out grounding accuracy and online task success.
  • If offline step rewards recognize only logged actions, reuse the KL-constrained RL ablation protocol and compare offline/online checkpoint correlation before scaling training.
  • Do not reuse the acceptance rule unchanged when the target environment lacks coordinates/targets or when valid actions cannot be sampled for false-negative auditing.

• 如果已有带截图和动作、但推理较弱的 GUI 轨迹，可复用补充生成、动作一致性和坐标包含过滤，产出推理动作 SFT 记录；用留出集定位准确率与在线任务成功率验收。
  • 如果离线逐步奖励只能识别日志动作，可复用 KL 约束的 RL 消融方案，并在扩大训练前比较 checkpoint 的离线与在线相关性。
  • 当目标环境没有坐标或目标字段，或无法采样有效替代动作来审计假阴性时，不应原样复用其接受规则。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: scarce action-aligned GUI rationales and ambiguous step reward are treated as one data-to-training problem.
  • Method handle: clean trajectories, augment rationale/action JSON, filter agreement/coordinates, run action-aware SFT, then KL-constrained RL.
  • Data/artifact handle: GUI-Libra-81K contains 81K steps from 9K trajectories; official project, GitHub, Hugging Face, and models are linked, but release license needs checking.
  • Evidence anchor: Qwen3-VL-8B rises 30.4→42.6 on AndroidWorld; KL changes offline/online Pearson correlation from 0.63 to 0.89 under the reported setup.
  • Reuse decision: useful for static GUI trajectories; first audit action coverage, mobile/web balance, and reward false negatives on valid alternatives.

• 一句话定位： 动作对齐 GUI 推理稀缺与逐步奖励有歧义，被统一为数据到训练的同一个问题。
  • 方法抓手： 清理轨迹、补充推理动作 JSON、过滤动作与坐标、执行 action-aware SFT，再做 KL 约束 RL。
  • 数据与产物抓手： GUI-Libra-81K 含 9K 条轨迹的 81K 个步骤；项目、GitHub、Hugging Face 和模型有官方链接，但许可仍需检查。
  • 证据锚点： Qwen3-VL-8B 在 AndroidWorld 上从 30.4 提高到 42.6；在论文设置下，KL 把离线与在线 Pearson 相关性从 0.63 提高到 0.89。
  • 复用决定： 适合已有静态 GUI 轨迹的场景；复用前先审计动作覆盖、移动端与网页比例，以及有效替代动作上的奖励假阴性。
